storage: Airtight jar in a cool, dry cupboard for 2 to 3 months once opened; in Mumbai's monsoon keep the jar dry and away from the stove. Overnight oats jars keep 2 days in the fridge.
looksLike: Flat, pale-beige, oval flakes, thicker and sturdier than instant oats, which look like fine bits or powder.
howToPick: Choose whole, thick, even flakes (not powder or curled bits), with a mild, sweet, nutty smell. Avoid packs that smell musty or bitter, have clumps or show moisture or insect webbing. For a gluten-free diet pick oats labelled gluten-free, because plain oats are often cross-contaminated with wheat.
shelfLife: About 9 to 12 months sealed (check the printed best-before date).

usedIn.raw: 40 g raw rolled oats per serving (½ cup)
